records.research_question: Does higher same-date ADX have a positive association with subsequent stock and benchmark-relative returns in a prospectively frozen evaluation?
records.expected_relationship: Higher ADX is expected to be associated with higher forward returns.
records.universe_definition: Point-in-time database-coverage universe with 50 observed-session history and five-VNINDEX-session staleness.
universe_limitations: Database coverage is local data availability, not historical VN100 membership.
Historical listing, delisting and ticker-change provenance is incomplete.
records.feature_availability_timing: ADX is available only after the completed signal-session OHLC is known.
records.outcome_definition: Stock forward return and VNINDEX-relative forward return must remain separate outcomes.
methodological_limitations: Historical discovery and temporal review reuse the same dataset.
Forward horizons overlap and observations are not independent.
No multiple-testing correction or dependence-adjusted uncertainty is available.
Historical corporate-action and price-adjustment provenance is unresolved.

lifecycle_history.reason: Draft created from prior retrospective evidence; prospective declarations remain unresolved.

records.research_question: Does an ADX-only equal-weight point-in-time portfolio produce positive benchmark-relative forward outcomes under a separately frozen prospective protocol?
records.expected_relationship: ADX-ranked equal-weight selections are expected to have positive VNINDEX-relative forward returns.
records.universe_definition: Point-in-time database-coverage universe with 50 observed-session history and five-VNINDEX-session staleness.
universe_limitations: Database coverage is not historical VN100 membership.
The existing Forward V1 observations predate this registry and are not independent evidence for a newly registered revision.
records.feature_availability_timing: Selection is formed only after the completed market session used to calculate ADX.
records.outcome_definition: Portfolio stock return and VNINDEX-relative return are separate, non-compounded forward observations.
methodological_limitations: Historical outcomes overlap and do not define an executable wealth path.
Historical friction evidence is hypothetical rather than a measured cost estimate.
Historical monetary capacity is not defensible.
Historical corporate-action and price-adjustment provenance is unresolved.

records.research_question: Does the frozen Q70 Hybrid Trend/Donchian policy retain positive net portfolio performance in a future independently registered protocol?
records.expected_relationship: The frozen policy is expected to produce positive net portfolio performance after costs.
records.universe_definition: Unresolved for a future registry protocol; historical evidence includes current-VN100-retroactive and database-coverage arms.
universe_limitations: Neither historical arm reconstructs historical VN100 membership.
The paired historical arms were trade-identical under the available database and strategy warmup.
Historical listing, delisting and ticker-change provenance is incomplete.
records.feature_availability_timing: Signals are formed after the completed daily session; historical simulation uses the frozen next-session execution contract.
methodological_limitations: The policy and related research choices were informed by previously observed historical results.
Historical execution remains simulated rather than broker-reconciled.
Historical adjustment and corporate-action provenance is unresolved.
Existing paper and Forward observations must not be relabeled as prospective evidence for this draft.
